user.title: Connect to Osmund Energi
user.description: Enter your personal Osmund Energi API key created on My page ({api_url}). Requires Osmund Plus on at least one location.

data_description.api_key: Your personal Osmund Energi API key starting with osm_.
data_description.redact_location_labels: Hide location labels when exporting diagnostics (recommended if your app label contains a street address).

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Osmund Energi
reauth_confirm.description: Your Osmund Energi API key is invalid, expired, or revoked. Create a new key on My page and enter it below.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Osmund Energi API. Please try again.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid, expired, or revoked API key.
error.no_api_access: No locations on this account have Osmund Plus API access enabled.

abort.already_configured: This Osmund Energi API key is already configured.

data_description.price_resolution: Auto follows each location's meter resolution (15-minute or hourly) and falls back to hourly.
data_description.redact_location_labels: Hide location labels when exporting diagnostics (recommended if your app label contains a street address).

get_prices.name: Get electricity prices
get_prices.description: Return cached electricity price intervals (and cost components) for today and/or tomorrow without making extra API calls when already cached.

config_entry_id.name: Integration entry
config_entry_id.description: Osmund Energi config entry (optional when only one is configured).

location_id.name: Location ID
location_id.description: Osmund location ID (optional when only one location has API access).

day.name: Day
day.description: Which Danish day(s) to return prices for.

resolution.name: Resolution
resolution.description: Override the configured interval resolution (hourly or quarter-hourly).
